children.value: > Fact From Story: Brand accounts started joining in on the Gag City hype.

> > Fact From Story: Gag City doesn’t bank on being the viral song of the summer to drive streaming numbers — the bit is removed enough for non-stans to enjoy it, while still revolving around the album it’s promoting.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If a meme is enjoyable it will be shared.
> Fact From Story: With Gag City, Minaj has brands doing all of her marketing for her.
> > Fact From Story: On one hand, memes tend to die the minute brand accounts start co-opting them — nothing is more tiresome than seeing a fun joke turn into a corporate-friendly marketing ploy.
> > > > Fact From Story: Chili’s posted an image of rosy smoke billowing from its restaurant.
> > > > Fact From Story: Never one to miss out on an easy trend, brand accounts started joining in on the Gag City hype.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies market to increase profits.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Marketing is a form of promotion.
